tasks.name: Create basic frontend layout
tasks.description: Design a single-page layout with a text input field and a save button.

tasks.name: Implement text input functionality
tasks.description: Enable users to type text into the input field.

tasks.name: Set up backend server
tasks.description: Create a backend server to handle note-saving requests.

tasks.name: Create API endpoint for saving notes
tasks.description: Develop an API endpoint to receive and store notes from the frontend.

tasks.name: Connect frontend to backend
tasks.description: Integrate the frontend with the backend API to send notes for saving.

tasks.name: Set up database for storing notes
tasks.description: Create a database to store user notes persistently.

tasks.name: Integrate database with backend
tasks.description: Connect the backend server to the database for saving and retrieving notes.

tasks.name: Test note-saving functionality
tasks.description: Ensure that notes can be saved and retrieved correctly.

tasks.name: Deploy application
tasks.description: Deploy the application to a hosting platform for user access.

T1.implementation_approach: Use HTML, CSS, and a frontend framework like React to create a basic layout with sections for input and displaying notes.
T1.notes: Ensure the layout is responsive and user-friendly.

T2.implementation_approach: Add a text input field and a button using React state to handle user input.
T2.notes: Validate input to prevent empty submissions.

T3.implementation_approach: Set up a Node.js server using Express to handle API requests.
T3.notes: Ensure the server is configured to handle CORS for frontend-backend communication.

T4.implementation_approach: Create a POST API endpoint in the backend to accept and save note data.
T4.notes: Validate incoming data and handle errors gracefully.

T5.implementation_approach: Use Axios or Fetch API in the frontend to send requests to the backend API.
T5.notes: Test connectivity between frontend and backend thoroughly.

T6.implementation_approach: Set up a database like MongoDB or PostgreSQL with a table/collection for storing notes.
T6.notes: Define a schema to structure the note data.

T7.implementation_approach: Integrate the database with the backend using an ORM like Mongoose or Sequelize.
T7.notes: Test database queries to ensure data is saved and retrieved correctly.

T8.implementation_approach: Write test cases to verify that notes are saved correctly and retrieved as expected.
T8.notes: Use tools like Postman or automated testing frameworks for thorough testing.

T9.implementation_approach: Deploy the application using a platform like Heroku, Vercel, or AWS.
T9.notes: Ensure environment variables and database connections are properly configured.
